// Every pattern the tracker depends on in obra/superpowers, in one place.
// Built against superpowers 6.4.2 (commit 8ca22db). A new superpowers
// release that changes a format means editing this file alone.

export const BUILT_AGAINST = '6.4.2'

export const SKILLS = [
  'using-superpowers',
  'brainstorming',
  'using-git-worktrees',
  'writing-plans',
  'subagent-driven-development',
  'executing-plans',
  'test-driven-development',
  'systematic-debugging',
  'verification-before-completion',
  'requesting-code-review',
  'receiving-code-review',
  'dispatching-parallel-agents',
  'finishing-a-development-branch',
  'writing-skills',
  'diagnosing-superpowers',
] as const
export type SkillName = (typeof SKILLS)[number]

const SKILL_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(SKILLS)

/** `superpowers:brainstorming` → `brainstorming`; undefined for a skill not ours. */
export const normalizeSkill = (raw: string | undefined): SkillName | undefined => {
  if (!raw) return undefined
  const bare = raw.trim().replace(/^\//, '').split(/\s+/)[0] ?? ''
  const name = bare.includes(':') ? bare.slice(bare.lastIndexOf(':') + 1) : bare
  return SKILL_SET.has(name) ? (name as SkillName) : undefined
}

/** A Read of a SKILL.md under a superpowers install. */
export const SKILL_FILE = /superpowers[^\s]*\/skills\/([a-z-]+)\/SKILL\.md$/

// Bootstrap: hooks/session-start wraps using-superpowers in this block.
export const BOOTSTRAP = /<EXTREMELY_IMPORTANT>\s*You have superpowers\./

// Brainstorming path announcement ("this looks bounded, so I'll ...").
export const PATH_ANNOUNCE: readonly [RegExp, 'spike' | 'bounded' | 'architectural'][] = [
  [/\b(?:this|it)\s+(?:looks|is|seems|reads)\s+(?:like\s+)?(?:an?\s+)?architectural\b/i, 'architectural'],
  [/\b(?:this|it)\s+(?:looks|is|seems|reads)\s+(?:like\s+)?(?:a\s+)?bounded\b/i, 'bounded'],
  [/\b(?:this|it)\s+(?:looks|is|seems|reads)\s+(?:like\s+)?(?:a\s+)?spike\b/i, 'spike'],
  [/\b(?:classif(?:y|ied|ying)\s+(?:this|it)\s+as|taking the)\s+(architectural|bounded|spike)\b/i, 'architectural'],
]

// Artifacts.
export const specFile = (specDir: string): RegExp =>
  new RegExp(`(^|/)${escape(specDir)}/(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-[^/]+-design\\.md)$`)
export const planFile = (planDir: string): RegExp =>
  new RegExp(`(^|/)${escape(planDir)}/([^/]+\\.md)$`)
export const SUPERPOWERS_DOCS = /(^|\/)docs\/superpowers\//
export const DOC_FILE = /\.(md|mdx|txt|rst|adoc)$/i
export const SP_PRIVATE = /(^|\/)\.superpowers\//

// SDD workspace and scripts.
export const WORKSPACE_DIR = /(\/[^\s'"]*\/\.superpowers\/sdd\/[^/\s'"]+)/
export const LEDGER_NAME = 'progress.md'
export const SCRIPT = /\b(sdd-workspace|task-brief|review-package|task-start|task-done)\b/
export const SCRIPT_ARGS = /\b(sdd-workspace|task-brief|review-package|task-start|task-done)\s+("[^"]+"|'[^']+'|\S+)(?:\s+(\d+))?(?:\s+([0-9a-f]{7,40}))?/
export const OUT_TASK_BRIEF = /^wrote (.+\/task-(\d+)-brief\.md): \d+ lines$/m
export const OUT_REVIEW_PKG = /^wrote (.+\/review-([0-9a-f]+)\.\.([0-9a-f]+)\.diff): (\d+) commit\(s\)/m
export const OUT_TASK_START_BRIEF = /^brief: (.+)$/m
export const OUT_TASK_START_BASE = /^base: ([0-9a-f]{7,40})$/m
export const OUT_TASK_DONE_LEDGER = /^ledger: (.+)$/m
export const OUT_TASK_DONE_FAIL = /task-done: test command exited (\d+); Task (\d+) NOT recorded/
export const TASK_REPORT = /\/task-(\d+)-report\.md/

// Plan structure. task-brief accepts any heading depth: /^#+[ \t]+Task[ \t]+N/.
export const FENCE = /^(```|~~~)/
export const TASK_HEADING = /^#+[ \t]+Task[ \t]+(\d+)\s*[:.\-–—]?\s*(.*)$/
export const PLAN_TITLE = /^#\s+(.+?)\s*$/
export const PLAN_GOAL = /^\*\*Goal:\*\*\s*(.+)$/
export const PLAN_SPEC = /^\*\*Spec:\*\*\s*`?([^`]+?)`?\s*$/
export const REVIEW_FOCUS = /^##\s+Review Focus\b/
export const STEP_OPEN = /^\s*[-*]\s+\[ \]/
export const STEP_DONE = /^\s*[-*]\s+\[[xX]\]/

// Ledger lines (progress.md). Unknown lines are kept, never fatal.
export const L = {
  title: /^#\s*SDD ledger\s*[—–-]\s*plan:\s*(.+)$/,
  preflight: /^Pre-flight:\s*(.+)$/,
  table: /^\|.*\|\s*$/,
  complete: /^Task\s+(\d+):\s*complete\s*\((?:commits\s+)?([0-9a-f]{4,40}\.\.[0-9a-f]{4,40})?,?\s*(.*)\)\s*$/,
  fixRound: /^Task\s+(\d+):\s*fix round\s+(\d+)\s*\/\s*5\s*\((\d+)\s+addressed,\s*(\d+)\s+open(.*)\)\s*$/,
  minor: /^Task\s+(\d+):\s*minor \(deferred\):\s*(.+)$/,

  taskRuling: /^Task\s+(\d+):\s*Ruling:\s*(.+)$/,
  ruling: /^Ruling:\s*(.+)$/,
  finalMinor: /^Final:\s*minor \(deferred\):\s*(.+)$/,
  finalFixed: /^Final:\s*fixed\s+(.+)$/,
  finalRuling: /^Final:\s*Ruling:\s*(.+)$/,
  finalReview: /^Final review:\s*(.+)$/,
} as const

// Subagent roles, from the dispatch description and prompt.
export const ROLE: readonly [RegExp, 'implementer' | 'task-reviewer' | 're-reviewer' | 'final-reviewer' | 'investigator' | 'analyst' | 'spec-reviewer'][] = [
  [/^Re-review\b|scoped re-review|re-reviewing one task's fix round/i, 're-reviewer'],
  [/^Review Task\s+\d+|reviewing one task's implementation/i, 'task-reviewer'],
  [/^Implement Task\s+\d+|You are implementing Task\s+\d+/i, 'implementer'],
  [/whole[- ]branch|final (?:code )?review|Senior Code Reviewer|^Review code changes/i, 'final-reviewer'],
  [/analyst-common|skill-timeline|plan-adherence|repeated-work|quality-evidence|cost-and-time|request-conflicts|diagnosing-superpowers/i, 'analyst'],
  [/spec[- ]document[- ]reviewer|review (?:the|this) spec/i, 'spec-reviewer'],
  [/\binvestigat|independent (?:problem )?domain|in parallel\b/i, 'investigator'],
]
export const TASK_N = /\bTask\s+(\d+)\b/
export const FIX_ROUND_N = /fix round\s+(\d+)/i

// Subagent answers.
export const A = {
  status: /\*\*Status:\*\*\s*(DONE_WITH_CONCERNS|DONE|BLOCKED|NEEDS_CONTEXT)/,
  commit: /\b([0-9a-f]{7,12})\b\s+[-—:]?\s*\S/g,
  testLine: /(\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\s+passing[^\n]*|\d+\s+passed[^\n]*|\d+\s+tests?[^\n]*(?:pass|fail)[^\n]*)/i,
  reportPath: /(\S+\/task-\d+-report\.md)/,
  specOk: /✅\s*Spec compliant/,
  specBad: /❌\s*Issues found/,
  specWarn: /⚠️\s*Cannot verify/,
  quality: /\*\*Task quality:\*\*\s*\[?\s*(Approved|Needs fixes)/i,
  section: /^#{3,4}\s+(Critical|Important|Minor)\b/i,
  addressed: /[—–-]\s*ADDRESSED\b/g,
  notAddressed: /[—–-]\s*NOT ADDRESSED\b/g,
  roundVerdict: /\*\*Fix round:\*\*\s*\[?\s*(All findings addressed[^\]\n]*|Findings remain open[^\]\n]*)/i,
  readyToMerge: /\*\*Ready to merge(?:\?\*\*|:)\s*\[?\s*(Yes|No|With fixes)/i,
} as const

// Main-loop answers.
export const SUCCESS_CLAIM = /\b(all (?:the )?tests? (?:are )?pass(?:ing|es)?|tests? (?:now )?pass|(?:is|are|now) fixed|it'?s fixed|fixed it|(?:is |are |everything is )?(?:done|complete)\b|ready to merge|works now)\b/i
export const PERFORMATIVE = /^\s*(?:You'?re absolutely right|Absolutely right|Great point|Excellent (?:feedback|point|catch)|Good catch|Thanks for catching)\b/i
export const RULINGS_LIST = /Rulings I made/i
export const MINORS_LIST = /Deferred minors/i
export const DIAGNOSE_PHRASE = 'figure out what went wrong with superpowers in this session'

// Git and worktree commands seen in Bash.
export const G = {
  worktreeAdd: /\bgit\s+worktree\s+add\b/,
  worktreeRemove: /\bgit\s+worktree\s+remove\b/,
  commit: /\bgit\s+commit\b/,
  merge: /\bgit\s+merge\b/,
  push: /\bgit\s+push\b[^\n]*\s-u\b|\bgit\s+push\s+-u\b|\bgit\s+push\b/,
  prCreate: /\bgh\s+pr\s+create\b|\bglab\s+mr\s+create\b/,
  branchDelete: /\bgit\s+branch\s+-[dD]\b/,
  workspaceDelete: /\brm\s+-r?f?r?\s+[^\n]*\.superpowers\/sdd\//,
  startServer: /\bstart-server\.sh\b/,
} as const

// Visual companion.
export const BRAINSTORM_DIR = '.superpowers/brainstorm'

// Model tiers.
export const tierOf = (model: string | undefined): 'cheap' | 'mid' | 'top' | 'unknown' => {
  if (!model) return 'unknown'
  if (/haiku/i.test(model)) return 'cheap'
  if (/sonnet/i.test(model)) return 'mid'
  if (/opus|fable/i.test(model)) return 'top'
  return 'unknown'
}

// Verification commands that back a success claim in the same turn.
export const VERIFY_HINT = /\b(test|tests|pytest|jest|vitest|cargo|go test|rspec|lint|tsc|typecheck|build|check|verify|validate|curl)\b/i

function escape(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '')
}

// State to plain view data, shared by every surface; renderers only draw.

import type {
  Agent,
  DemoState,
  Env,
  Ledger,
  ResumeState,
  Run,
  Settings,
  SkillHit,
  StageId,
  TestRun,
  TimelineRow,
  UiState,
  Warning,
} from '../../types'
import { STAGE_INITIAL, STAGE_LABEL, STAGES, executeProgress, stageIndex } from '../stages'
import { openWarnings, topSeverity } from '../warnings'
import { rulingCount } from '../parsers'
import { fmtAgo } from '../core'
import { GLYPH, SEV_COLOR, brandRamp, tintOf, type Tokens } from './theme'
import { sparkline } from './cells'
import { roleLabel } from '../signals/agents'

export type World = {
  run: Run
  timeline: TimelineRow[]
  skills: SkillHit[]
  agents: Agent[]
  ledger: Ledger
  tests: TestRun[]
  warnings: Warning[]
  env: Env
  ui: UiState
  resume: ResumeState
  settings: Settings
  demo: DemoState
}

export type Tier = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
export const bandTier = (columns: number): Tier => (columns < 50 ? 'xs' : columns < 90 ? 'sm' : columns < 140 ? 'md' : 'lg')

export const SHIP_HOLD_MS = 30_000
export const SHIP_SPARK_MS = 1_500

export type RailStop = { id: StageId; label: string; initial: string; hue: string; state: 'done' | 'current' | 'future'; inferred: boolean }
export type AgentChip = { role: string; glyph: string; model: string; task?: number; title: string; startedAt: number }

export type BandVM = {
  kind: 'armed' | 'resume' | 'live' | 'shipped'
  tier: Tier
  columns: number
  motion: boolean
  working: boolean
  now: number
  pulseAt: number
  version: string
  mode: 'observe' | 'assist' | 'strict'
  c: { muted: string; text: string; ok: string; warn: string; critical: string; hue: string; tint: string | null; brand: string[]; ansi: boolean }
  rail: RailStop[]
  path: string | null
  pathInferred: boolean
  progress: { done: number; total: number; fraction: number } | null
  title: string | null
  pills: { rulings: number; agents: number; warnings: number; warnColor: string }
  agents: AgentChip[]
  fix: { round: number; breaker: boolean; task: number } | null
  tdd: { dots: boolean[]; green: boolean } | null
  spark: string
  idle: string
  critical: { id: string; text: string; evidence: string } | null
  resume: { title: string; kind: string; label: string; done: number; total: number; current: number | null; fixRound: number | null; ago: string; rulings: number; more: number; hue: string } | null
  shipped: string | null
}

const PATH_TAG = { architectural: 'ARCH', bounded: 'BOUNDED', spike: 'SPIKE' } as const

export const visibleCandidates = (r: ResumeState) => r.candidates.filter(c => !r.dismissed.includes(c.id))

/** What the band shows now, or null for nothing (dormant, off, compact while idle). */
export const buildBand = (
  w: World,
  t: Tokens,
  o: { columns: number; now: number; working: boolean; version: string },
): BandVM | null => {
  const { run, settings } = w
  if (settings.band === 'off' || run.lifecycle === 'dormant') return null
  const shippedRecently = run.shippedAt !== undefined && o.now - run.shippedAt < SHIP_HOLD_MS
  const candidates = visibleCandidates(w.resume)
  const top = candidates[0]
  const isLive = run.lifecycle === 'live' || (run.lifecycle === 'shipped' && !shippedRecently && run.stage !== 'finish')
  const kind: BandVM['kind'] = shippedRecently
    ? 'shipped'
    : isLive && run.lifecycle === 'live'
      ? 'live'
      : top
        ? 'resume'
        : 'armed'
  if (kind === 'armed' && settings.band === 'compact') return null

  const stage = kind === 'resume' && top ? top.stage : run.stage
  const hue = kind === 'shipped' ? t.stage.finish : t.stage[stage]
  const rail: RailStop[] = STAGES.map(id => ({
    id,
    label: STAGE_LABEL[id],
    initial: STAGE_INITIAL[id],
    hue: t.stage[id],
    state: stageIndex(id) < stageIndex(stage) ? 'done' : id === stage ? 'current' : 'future',
    inferred: id === stage && run.stageInferred,
  }))
  const prog = kind === 'resume' && top ? { done: top.done, total: top.total, fraction: top.total ? top.done / top.total : 0 } : executeProgress(run)
  const open = openWarnings(w.warnings)
  const sev = topSeverity(w.warnings)
  const running = w.agents.filter(a => a.status === 'running')
  const crit = open.find(x => x.sev === 'critical')
  const current = run.tasks.find(x => x.n === run.currentTask)
  const rulings = kind === 'resume' && top ? top.rulings : rulingCount(w.ledger.entries)
  const lastDone = run.lastDone
  const idle = lastDone ? `last: Task ${lastDone.n} ${GLYPH.check} ${fmtAgo(o.now - lastDone.at)}` : run.planTitle ? `plan: ${run.planTitle}` : 'ready'
  const label =
    top?.kind === 'live-elsewhere'
      ? '◐ live in another session (likely)'
      : top?.kind === 'planned'
        ? 'planned, not executed'
        : top?.kind === 'spec'
          ? 'spec awaiting a plan'
          : top?.kind === 'companion'
            ? 'companion'
            : top?.kind === 'orphan'
              ? 'orphaned workspace'
              : 'resumable'

  return {
    kind,
    tier: bandTier(o.columns),
    columns: o.columns,
    motion: settings.motion && !t.ansi,
    working: o.working,
    now: o.now,
    pulseAt: run.pulseAt,
    version: o.version,
    mode: settings.mode,
    c: {
      muted: t.muted,
      text: t.text,
      ok: t.ok,
      warn: t.warn,
      critical: t.critical,
      hue,
      tint: tintOf(t, hue) ?? null,
      brand: brandRamp(t, 13),
      ansi: t.ansi,
    },
    rail,
    path: run.path ? PATH_TAG[run.path] : null,
    pathInferred: run.pathInferred,
    progress: prog.total > 0 ? prog : null,
    title: kind === 'resume' && top ? top.title : run.planTitle ?? null,
    pills: {
      rulings,
      agents: running.length,
      warnings: open.length,
      warnColor: sev ? SEV_COLOR(t, sev) : t.muted,
    },
    agents: running.slice(0, 3).map(a => ({
      role: roleLabel(a.role),
      glyph: GLYPH.tier[a.tier],
      model: a.model ? a.model.replace(/^claude-/, '').split('-')[0] ?? a.model : 'inherits',
      title: run.tasks.find(x => x.n === a.task)?.name ?? a.description,
      startedAt: a.startedAt,
      ...(a.task !== undefined ? { task: a.task } : {}),
    })),
    fix: current && current.fixRound > 0 ? { round: current.fixRound, breaker: current.breaker, task: current.n } : null,
    tdd: current && current.tdd.length ? { dots: current.tdd.slice(-6).map(d => d.ok), green: current.tdd.some(d => !d.ok) && current.tdd.at(-1)?.ok === true } : null,
    spark: sparkline(w.env.context, 8),
    idle,
    critical: crit ? { id: crit.id, text: crit.text, evidence: crit.evidence } : null,
    resume:
      kind === 'resume' && top
        ? {
            title: top.title,
            kind: top.kind,
            label,
            done: top.done,
            total: top.total,
            current: top.current ?? null,
            fixRound: top.fixRound ?? null,
            ago: fmtAgo(o.now - top.mtime),
            rulings: top.rulings,
            more: candidates.length - 1,
            hue: t.stage[top.stage],
          }
        : null,
    shipped: kind === 'shipped' ? run.shipSummary ?? 'shipped' : null,
  }
}

/** The breadcrumb `plan › <basename> › Task 5`. */
export const breadcrumb = (run: Run): string[] => {
  const parts: string[] = [STAGE_LABEL[run.stage].toLowerCase()]
  if (run.planPath) parts.push((run.planPath.split('/').at(-1) ?? '').replace(/\.md$/, ''))
  if (run.currentTask !== undefined) parts.push(`Task ${run.currentTask}`)
  return parts
}

/** Plain-text status for `/sp status`. */
export const statusText = (w: World, now: number): string => {
  const { run } = w
  const p = executeProgress(run)
  const open = openWarnings(w.warnings)
  const lines = [
    `ϟ superpowers-tracker · ${run.lifecycle} · stage ${STAGE_LABEL[run.stage]}${run.stageInferred ? '?' : ''}${run.path ? ` · path ${run.path}${run.pathInferred ? '?' : ''}` : ''}`,
  ]
  if (run.planPath) lines.push(`plan: ${run.planTitle ?? run.planPath} (${run.planPath})`)
  if (p.total) lines.push(`tasks: ${p.done}/${p.total} done${run.currentTask !== undefined ? ` · current Task ${run.currentTask}` : ''}${run.executor ? ` · executor ${run.executor === 'sdd' ? 'subagent-driven-development' : 'executing-plans'}` : ''}`)
  for (const t of run.tasks) {
    const g = t.status === 'done' ? '●' : t.status === 'parked' ? '⚠' : t.status === 'blocked' ? '✗' : t.status === 'pending' ? '○' : '◐'
    lines.push(`  ${g} ${String(t.n).padStart(2)} ${t.name}${t.fixRound ? ` · fix ${t.fixRound}/5` : ''}${t.commits ? ` · ${t.commits}` : ''}`)
  }
  const minors = w.ledger.entries.filter(e => e.kind === 'minor' || e.kind === 'final-minor').length
  lines.push(`rulings: ${rulingCount(w.ledger.entries)} · deferred minors: ${minors}`)
  lines.push(open.length ? `open warnings (${open.length}):` : 'open warnings: none')
  for (const x of open.slice(0, 8)) lines.push(`  ${x.sev === 'critical' ? '✗' : x.sev === 'warn' ? '⚠' : '·'} ${x.text} — ${x.evidence}`)
  if (run.lastDone) lines.push(`last completion: Task ${run.lastDone.n}, ${fmtAgo(now - run.lastDone.at)}`)
  return lines.join('\n')
}

// The pane's chrome: a round border in the stage hue, the header with its
// breadcrumb and mode badge, the segmented tab control, the footer hints.

import type { RenderElement, RenderNode } from 'claude-code'
import { Skeleton, type PaneCtx } from './kit'
import { Flow } from './Flow'
import { Plan } from './Plan'
import { Agents } from './Agents'
import { Ledger } from './Ledger'
import { Tests } from './Tests'
import { Workspace } from './Workspace'
import { Warnings } from './Warnings'
import { breadcrumb } from '../viewModel'
import { tintOf } from '../theme'
import { BUILT_AGAINST } from '../../patterns'
import { clip } from '../cells'

export const TABS = ['Flow', 'Plan', 'Agents', 'Ledger', 'Tests', 'Workspace', 'Warnings'] as const
const BODY = [Flow, Plan, Agents, Ledger, Tests, Workspace, Warnings] as const

export const PaneView = (c: PaneCtx): RenderElement => {
  const { Box, Text, Button } = c.els
  const { run, ui, settings, env } = c.w
  const hue = c.t.stage[run.stage]
  const tab = Math.min(TABS.length, Math.max(1, ui.tab))
  const crumbs = breadcrumb(run)
  const mode = settings.mode
  const badge =
    mode === 'strict' ? <Text color={c.t.critical} inverse bold>{' STRICT '}</Text> : mode === 'assist' ? <Text color={c.t.stage.plan} inverse>{' ASSIST '}</Text> : <Text color={c.t.muted}>{' OBSERVE '}</Text>
  const body = c.loading ? Skeleton(c) : BODY[tab - 1]!(c)
  const openWarnings = c.w.warnings.filter(w => !w.acked).length
  return (
    <Box flexDirection="column" borderStyle="round" borderColor={hue} borderDimColor={!c.focused} paddingX={2} paddingY={0}>
      <Box flexDirection="row" justifyContent="space-between">
        <Box flexGrow={1} flexShrink={1} overflow="hidden">
        <Text wrap="truncate-end">
          <Text color={c.t.brand[0]} bold>{'ϟ '}</Text>
          <Text bold>superpowers</Text>
          <Text color={c.t.muted}>{'  '}</Text>
          {crumbs.map((p, i) => (
            <Text color={i === crumbs.length - 1 ? hue : c.t.muted}>{`${i ? ' › ' : ''}${clip(p, 28)}`}</Text>
          ))}
        </Text>
        </Box>
        <Box flexShrink={0}>
          <Text>
            {badge}
            <Text color={c.t.muted}>{`  ${env.pluginVersion ?? BUILT_AGAINST}`}</Text>
          </Text>
        </Box>
      </Box>
      <Box flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" columnGap={1} marginTop={1}>
        {TABS.map((name, i) => {
          const active = i + 1 === tab
          const label = name === 'Warnings' && openWarnings ? `${name} ${openWarnings}` : name
          return active ? (
            <Text key={`tab-${i}`} color={hue} inverse bold>{` ${i + 1} ${label} `}</Text>
          ) : (
            <Button key={`tab${i + 1}`} label={label} hotkey={String(i + 1)} plain dimColor hover={{ scope: `sp-tab${i + 1}`, color: c.t.text }} onPress={() => c.act.tab(i + 1)} />
          )
        })}
      </Box>
      <Box flexDirection="column">
        {body}
      </Box>
      <Box flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" columnGap={2} marginTop={1}>
        <Button key="prev" label="up" hotkey="k" plain dimColor onPress={() => c.act.select(Math.max(0, ui.selection - 1))} />
        <Button key="next" label="down" hotkey="j" plain dimColor onPress={() => c.act.select(ui.selection + 1)} />
        <Button key="expand" label="expand" hotkey="v" plain dimColor onPress={() => c.act.expand(ui.expanded === ui.selection ? -1 : ui.selection)} />
        <Button key="tabnext" label="next tab" hotkey="n" plain dimColor onPress={() => c.act.tab((tab % TABS.length) + 1)} />
        <Button key="tabprev" label="prev tab" hotkey="p" plain dimColor onPress={() => c.act.tab(((tab + TABS.length - 2) % TABS.length) + 1)} />
        <Button key="export" label="export" hotkey="e" plain dimColor onPress={() => c.act.exportRun()} />
        <Button key="close" label="close" hotkey="q" plain dimColor role="dismiss" onPress={() => c.act.close()} />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  )
}

// /sp demo: a scripted 60-second run through every state, computed purely
// from elapsed time. It never touches the real tracker state.

import type { Agent, LedgerEntry, Run, StageId, TaskRow, TimelineRow, Warning } from '../../types'
import type { World } from './viewModel'
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, FRESH_ENV, FRESH_RESUME, FRESH_UI, freshRun } from '../state'
import { blankTask } from '../core'

export const DEMO_MS = 60_000

const NAMES = [
  'Retry policy types',
  'Backoff calculator',
  'Jitter strategies',
  'Circuit breaker state',
  'HTTP client wrapper',
  'Idempotency keys',
  'Metrics and tracing',
  'Config loader',
  'Docs and examples',
]

// Each task's window inside the execute phase (14 s → 48 s).
const EXEC_START = 14_000
const SLOT = 3_700

export const demoWorld = (elapsed: number, start: number, mode: World['settings']['mode'] = 'observe'): World => {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(DEMO_MS, elapsed))
  const at = (ms: number) => start + ms
  const now = at(t)
  const timeline: TimelineRow[] = []
  const agents: Agent[] = []
  const entries: LedgerEntry[] = [{ kind: 'title', text: 'docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-05-retry-policy.md', line: 1 }]
  const warnings: Warning[] = []
  const push = (ms: number, kind: TimelineRow['kind'], label: string, stage: StageId, extra: Partial<TimelineRow> = {}) => {
    if (t >= ms) timeline.push({ at: at(ms), kind, label, stage, ...extra })
  }

  let stage: StageId = 'brainstorm'
  if (t >= 6_000) stage = 'spec'
  if (t >= 10_000) stage = 'plan'
  if (t >= EXEC_START) stage = 'execute'
  if (t >= 48_000) stage = 'review'
  if (t >= 54_000) stage = 'finish'

  push(0, 'skill', 'brainstorming', 'brainstorm')
  push(2_000, 'note', 'path: architectural?', 'brainstorm', { detail: 'announced' })
  push(6_000, 'artifact', 'spec retry-policy-design.md', 'spec', { ok: true })
  push(10_000, 'skill', 'writing-plans', 'plan')
  push(12_000, 'artifact', 'plan 2026-10-05-retry-policy.md', 'plan', { ok: true })
  push(13_000, 'skill', 'using-git-worktrees', 'execute')
  push(14_000, 'skill', 'subagent-driven-development', 'execute')

  const tasks: TaskRow[] = NAMES.map((name, i) => ({ ...blankTask(i + 1, name), steps: 5 }))
  let current: number | undefined
  tasks.forEach((task, i) => {
    const s = EXEC_START + i * SLOT
    const e = s + SLOT
    if (t < s) return
    const n = i + 1
    const doneAt = n === 3 ? e + 0 : e
    const running = t < doneAt
    task.startedAt = at(s)
    task.stepsDone = running ? Math.min(5, Math.floor(((t - s) / SLOT) * 5)) : 5
    task.tdd = [{ ok: false, at: at(s + 600) }, ...(t > s + 1200 ? [{ ok: true, at: at(s + 1200) }] : [])]
    task.agents = 2
    if (n === 3) {
      const round = Math.min(5, Math.max(0, Math.floor((t - s - 800) / 500)))
      task.fixRound = round
      task.breaker = round >= 5 && t > s + 3_300
      if (round > 0) entries.push({ kind: 'fix-round', task: 3, round, addressed: 1, open: round >= 5 ? 1 : 2, text: 'jitter bound off by one', line: 5 })
      if (task.breaker) entries.push({ kind: 'parked', task: 3, text: 'jitter upper bound — Ruling: spec allows inclusive bound', line: 7 })
    }
    if (n === 6 && t > s + 800 && t < s + 1_900) task.status = 'blocked'
    const implEnd = s + SLOT * 0.55
    agents.push({
      id: `demo-impl-${n}`,
      agentId: `demo-impl-${n}`,
      description: `Implement Task ${n}: ${task.name}`,
      subagentType: 'general-purpose',
      modelOmitted: false,
      model: n % 3 === 0 ? 'sonnet' : 'haiku',
      tier: n % 3 === 0 ? 'mid' : 'cheap',
      role: 'implementer',
      task: n,
      status: t < implEnd ? 'running' : n === 6 && t < s + 1_900 ? 'failed' : 'done',
      startedAt: at(s),
      ...(t >= implEnd ? { endedAt: at(implEnd), verdict: n === 6 ? 'NEEDS_CONTEXT' : 'DONE' } : {}),
    })
    if (t >= implEnd) {
      agents.push({
        id: `demo-rev-${n}`,
        agentId: `demo-rev-${n}`,
        description: `Review Task ${n} (spec + quality)`,
        subagentType: 'general-purpose',
        modelOmitted: false,
        model: 'sonnet',
        tier: 'mid',
        role: 'task-reviewer',
        task: n,
        status: t < e ? 'running' : 'done',
        startedAt: at(implEnd),
        ...(t >= e ? { endedAt: at(e), verdict: n === 3 ? 'Spec ✓ · Needs fixes' : 'Spec ✓ · Approved' } : {}),
      })
    }
    push(s, 'agent-start', `implementer · Task ${n}`, 'execute', { detail: n % 3 === 0 ? 'sonnet' : 'haiku' })
    push(implEnd, 'agent-end', `implementer · Task ${n} ✓`, 'execute', { ok: true })
    push(e, 'ledger', `Task ${n} complete`, 'execute', { ok: true })
    if (running) {
      current = n
      task.status = task.status === 'blocked' ? 'blocked' : n === 3 && task.fixRound > 0 ? 'fixing' : 'running'
    } else {
      task.status = n === 3 ? 'parked' : 'done'
      task.doneAt = at(e)
      task.commits = `${(0xa1b2c3d + n * 4099).toString(16).slice(0, 7)}..${(0xd4e5f6a + n * 7919).toString(16).slice(0, 7)}`
      entries.push({ kind: 'complete', task: n, text: n === 3 ? '1 parked' : 'review clean', line: 10 + n, ...(n === 3 ? { parked: 1 } : { clean: true }) })
    }
  })
  if (t >= 20_000) entries.push({ kind: 'ruling', text: 'Use exponential backoff with full jitter — the spec names AWS guidance — one more test if wrong', line: 3 })
  if (t >= 36_000) entries.push({ kind: 'minor', task: 5, text: 'client wrapper could expose timeout', line: 20 })
  if (t >= 40_000) {
    warnings.push({ id: 'demo:redispatch', code: 'redispatch-complete', sev: 'critical', text: 'Task 2 re-dispatched after it completed', evidence: 'ledger: Task 2: complete · Implement Task 2 (toolu_demo)', at: at(40_000), acked: t > 45_000 })
  }
  if (t >= 30_000) warnings.push({ id: 'demo:model', code: 'model-omitted', sev: 'warn', text: 'task reviewer dispatched with no explicit model', evidence: 'Review Task 5 (toolu_demo5)', at: at(30_000), acked: false })
  if (t >= 48_000) {
    agents.push({ id: 'demo-final', agentId: 'demo-final', description: 'Final whole-branch review', subagentType: 'general-purpose', modelOmitted: false, model: 'opus', tier: 'top', role: 'final-reviewer', status: t < 53_000 ? 'running' : 'done', startedAt: at(48_000), ...(t >= 53_000 ? { endedAt: at(53_000), verdict: 'Ready: Yes' } : {}) })
    push(48_000, 'agent-start', 'final reviewer', 'review', { detail: 'opus' })
  }
  if (t >= 53_000) push(53_000, 'agent-end', 'final reviewer ✓', 'review', { ok: true, detail: 'Ready: Yes' })
  if (t >= 54_000) push(54_000, 'skill', 'finishing-a-development-branch', 'finish')

  const run: Run = {
    ...freshRun(start),
    lifecycle: t >= 54_000 ? 'shipped' : 'live',
    stage,
    stageInferred: false,
    path: 'architectural',
    pathInferred: t < 6_000,
    approvalSeen: t >= 10_000,
    brainstormActive: t < 10_000,
    specPath: 'docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-05-retry-policy-design.md',
    specCommitted: t >= 7_000,
    ...(t >= 10_000 ? { planPath: '/repo/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-05-retry-policy.md', planTitle: 'Retry Policy', planGoal: 'Retries with backoff, jitter and a circuit breaker for the HTTP client.' } : {}),
    hasReviewFocus: true,
    tasks: t >= 10_000 ? tasks : [],
    executor: 'sdd',
    workspace: '/repo/.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-05-retry-policy',
    ...(current !== undefined ? { currentTask: current } : {}),
    pulseAt: pulseTime(t, start),
    ...(t >= 54_000 ? { shippedAt: at(54_000), shipSummary: '9 tasks · 47m · 0 critical' } : {}),
    ...(t >= 53_000 ? { finalReview: { verdict: 'Yes', critical: 0, important: 0, minor: 2, at: at(53_000) } } : {}),
    turn: Math.floor(t / 4000),
  }
  const last = tasks.filter(x => x.doneAt).at(-1)
  if (last?.doneAt) run.lastDone = { n: last.n, at: last.doneAt }
  void now
  return {
    run,
    timeline,
    skills: [],
    agents,
    ledger: { path: `${run.workspace}/progress.md`, mtime: now, size: 1, entries, unknown: [], readAt: now },
    tests: tasks.flatMap(x => x.tdd.map(d => ({ at: d.at, command: `npm test -- task${x.n}`, ok: d.ok, ref: `demo-${x.n}-${d.at}`, task: x.n }))),
    warnings,
    env: { ...FRESH_ENV, pluginVersion: '6.4.2', installed: true, branch: 'feature/retry-policy', isLinkedWorktree: true, repoRoot: '/repo', context: [12, 18, 24, 31, 38, 44, 52, 58].slice(0, 1 + Math.floor(t / 7500)), bootstrap: [{ at: start, ok: true, why: 'startup' }], costUsd: t / 20_000 },
    ui: FRESH_UI,
    resume: FRESH_RESUME,
    settings: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, mode },
    demo: { active: true, startedAt: start, step: Math.floor(t / 1000) },
  }
}

/** The moments a node lands (stage changes and task completions). */
const pulseTime = (t: number, start: number): number => {
  const marks = [0, 6_000, 10_000, EXEC_START, ...NAMES.map((_, i) => EXEC_START + (i + 1) * SLOT), 48_000, 54_000]
  const last = marks.filter(m => m <= t).at(-1) ?? 0
  return start + last
}

// Process warnings derived from the signals: a code, a severity, words.

import type { Severity, Warning } from '../types'

export type WarningCode =
  | 'code-before-approval'
  | 'impl-on-main'
  | 'model-omitted'
  | 'parallel-implementers'
  | 'nested-subagent'
  | 'redispatch-complete'
  | 'fix-loop-overrun'
  | 'breaker-unruled'
  | 'controller-edit'
  | 'bootstrap-missing'
  | 'debug-three-fixes'
  | 'unverified-claim'
  | 'performative-agreement'
  | 'rulings-lost'
  | 'impl-before-test'
  | 'strict-deny'

export const SEVERITY: Record<WarningCode, Severity> = {
  'code-before-approval': 'warn',
  'impl-on-main': 'warn',
  'model-omitted': 'warn',
  'parallel-implementers': 'warn',
  'nested-subagent': 'warn',
  'redispatch-complete': 'critical',
  'fix-loop-overrun': 'warn',
  'breaker-unruled': 'warn',
  'controller-edit': 'warn',
  'bootstrap-missing': 'warn',
  'debug-three-fixes': 'warn',
  'unverified-claim': 'info',
  'performative-agreement': 'info',
  'rulings-lost': 'warn',
  'impl-before-test': 'info',
  'strict-deny': 'warn',
}

export const SEV_RANK: Record<Severity, number> = { info: 0, warn: 1, critical: 2 }

export const makeWarning = (code: WarningCode, text: string, evidence: string, at: number, sev = SEVERITY[code]): Warning => ({
  id: `${code}:${evidence}`,
  code,
  sev,
  text,
  evidence,
  at,
  acked: false,
})

/** Adds a warning unless one with the same id stands; sorted by severity then time. */
export const addWarning = (list: readonly Warning[], w: Warning, cap: number): Warning[] => {
  if (list.some(x => x.id === w.id)) return [...list]
  const next = [...list, w]
  return next.length > cap ? next.slice(next.length - cap) : next
}

export const openWarnings = (list: readonly Warning[]): Warning[] =>
  list.filter(w => !w.acked).sort((a, b) => SEV_RANK[b.sev] - SEV_RANK[a.sev] || b.at - a.at)

export const topSeverity = (list: readonly Warning[]): Severity | undefined => openWarnings(list)[0]?.sev

// The superpowers-tracker contract: every value it keeps in $.state.

export type StageId = 'brainstorm' | 'spec' | 'plan' | 'execute' | 'review' | 'finish'
export type Lifecycle = 'dormant' | 'armed' | 'resumable' | 'live' | 'shipped'
export type BrainstormPath = 'spike' | 'bounded' | 'architectural'
export type Severity = 'info' | 'warn' | 'critical'
export type Mode = 'observe' | 'assist' | 'strict'
export type BandMode = 'auto' | 'always' | 'compact' | 'off'
export type ThemeChoice = 'auto' | 'dark' | 'light' | 'daltonized' | 'ansi'
export type AutoOpen = 'never' | 'resumable' | 'live'
export type Executor = 'sdd' | 'inline'
export type Tier = 'cheap' | 'mid' | 'top' | 'unknown'
export type Role =
  | 'implementer'
  | 'task-reviewer'
  | 're-reviewer'
  | 'final-reviewer'
  | 'investigator'
  | 'analyst'
  | 'spec-reviewer'
  | 'other'

export type TaskStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'fixing' | 'done' | 'parked' | 'blocked'

export type TestDot = { ok: boolean; at: number }

export type TaskRow = {
  n: number
  name: string
  steps: number
  stepsDone: number
  status: TaskStatus
  fixRound: number
  breaker: boolean
  commits?: string
  startedAt?: number
  doneAt?: number
  agents: number
  tdd: TestDot[]
  implFirst: boolean
  sawTestEdit: boolean
  ledger: string[]
  brief?: string
  report?: string
  verdict?: string
}

export type FinalReview = {
  verdict: string
  critical: number
  important: number
  minor: number
  at: number
}

export type Finishing = {
  option?: 'merge' | 'pr' | 'keep' | 'discard'
  worktreeRemoved: boolean
  branchDeleted: boolean
  workspaceDeleted: boolean
  rulingsListed: boolean
  minorsListed: boolean
}

export type Run = {
  lifecycle: Lifecycle
  stage: StageId
  stageInferred: boolean
  path?: BrainstormPath
  pathInferred: boolean
  approvalSeen: boolean
  brainstormActive: boolean
  debuggingActive: boolean
  specPath?: string
  specCommitted: boolean
  planPath?: string
  planTitle?: string
  planGoal?: string
  planSpec?: string
  hasReviewFocus: boolean
  planParseError?: string
  tasks: TaskRow[]
  executor?: Executor
  workspace?: string
  currentTask?: number
  base?: string
  finalReview?: FinalReview
  finishing?: Finishing
  pulseAt: number
  shippedAt?: number
  shipSummary?: string
  startedAt: number
  lastDone?: { n: number; at: number }
  turn: number
  turnHadVerification: boolean
  debugEditPending: boolean
  boundedDesignShown: boolean
  spectator: boolean
}

export type TimelineRow = {
  at: number
  kind: 'skill' | 'agent-start' | 'agent-end' | 'compact' | 'artifact' | 'ledger' | 'test' | 'warning' | 'note'

  agentId?: string
  ok?: boolean
  detail?: string
}

export type SkillHit = {
  skill: string
  at: number
  turn: number
  agentId?: string
  args?: string
  via: 'prompt' | 'tool' | 'read' | 'replay'
}

export type Agent = {
  id: string
  agentId?: string
  parentAgentId?: string
  description: string
  subagentType: string
  model?: string
  modelOmitted: boolean
  parentModel?: string
  tier: Tier
  role: Role
  task?: number
  status: 'running' | 'done' | 'failed'
  startedAt: number
  endedAt?: number
  verdict?: string
  summary?: string
}

export type LedgerKind =
  | 'title'
  | 'preflight'
  | 'complete'
  | 'fix-round'
  | 'minor'
  | 'parked'
  | 'task-ruling'
  | 'ruling'
  | 'final-minor'
  | 'final-fixed'
  | 'final-ruling'
  | 'final-review'

export type LedgerEntry = {
  kind: LedgerKind
  task?: number

  commits?: string
  round?: number
  addressed?: number
  open?: number

export type Ledger = {
  path?: string
  mtime: number
  size: number
  planRef?: string

  parseError?: string
  readAt: number
}

export type TestRun = {
  at: number
  command: string
  ok: boolean
  passed?: number
  failed?: number
  task?: number
  agentId?: string
  ref: string
}

export type Warning = {
  id: string
  code: string
  sev: Severity
  text: string

}

export type Companion = {
  dir: string
  url?: string
  port?: number

  stopped: boolean

}

export type Env = {
  pluginVersion?: string
  installed: boolean
  bootstrap: { at: number; ok: boolean; why: string }[]
  compactions: number[]
  branch?: string
  isLinkedWorktree: boolean
  repoRoot?: string
  worktreeEvents: number
  companion?: Companion
  sessionId?: string
  context: number[]

  debugFixes: number
  surface?: string
}

export type Candidate = {
  id: string
  kind: 'live-elsewhere' | 'mid-exec' | 'planned' | 'spec' | 'companion' | 'orphan'
  title: string
  stage: StageId
  planPath?: string
  specPath?: string
  workspace?: string
  worktree?: string
  done: number
  total: number
  current?: number
  fixRound?: number
  rulings: number
  mtime: number
  executor?: Executor
  suggest: string
  resumeCmd?: string
  url?: string
  dim: boolean
}

export type ResumeState = {
  candidates: Candidate[]
  dismissed: string[]
  scannedAt: number
  scanning: boolean
  toasted: string[]
  lastSession?: { id: string; ago: number; skill?: string }
}

export type UiState = {
  tab: number
  selection: number
  expanded: number
  filter: string
}

export type Settings = {
  mode: Mode
  band: BandMode
  motion: boolean
  theme: ThemeChoice
  toasts: boolean
  testRunners: string[]
  testFiles: string[]
  specDir: string
  planDir: string
  pollMs: number
  windowDays: number
  autoOpenPane: AutoOpen
}

export type DemoState = {
  active: boolean
  startedAt: number
  step: number
}

// Aliases: inside `declare module 'claude-code'` a bare name resolves to the
// engine's own type first (it has a `Settings`), so the contract names these.
export type SpRun = Run
export type SpTimeline = TimelineRow[]
export type SpSkills = SkillHit[]
export type SpAgents = Agent[]
export type SpLedger = Ledger
export type SpTests = TestRun[]
export type SpWarnings = Warning[]
export type SpEnv = Env
export type SpUi = UiState
export type SpResume = ResumeState
export type SpSettings = Settings
export type SpDemo = DemoState

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'superpowers-tracker': {
      run: SpRun
      timeline: SpTimeline
      skills: SpSkills
      agents: SpAgents
      ledger: SpLedger
      tests: SpTests
      warnings: SpWarnings
      env: SpEnv
      ui: SpUi
      resume: SpResume
      settings: SpSettings
      demo: SpDemo
    }
  }
}
